title: Account
activeSessionsDesc: Devices currently signed in to your account.
deleteAccountDesc: Danger zone: this permanently deletes your account and all of its data.
deleteAccountConfirm: This will permanently delete your account and all of its data. This action cannot be undone.
logoutEverywhereConfirm: This revokes every session, including this one. Because the current sign-in stays valid until it naturally expires, this device may keep working for a few minutes before it signs out too.
